name: redact-secrets
description: Masks emails, phone numbers, API keys, cards, IBANs and national IDs in prompts before they are sent

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Countries whose national ID numbers are masked: "all", or ISO codes separated by commas (IT, US, GB, ES, FR, BR, IN, MX, CN). Emails, phones, API keys, cards and IBANs are masked for every country.

color.title: Highlight color
color.description: Color of the masked values in the transcript.
